complete_examples.text: As presented in the standard,27 in order to test the lateral resistance of sleeper, ̄rst, the fasteners are released from the measured sleeper and the rail plate is removed.

From the ̄gure, the relationship between sleeper resistance and sleeper displacement is nonlinear, the waveform is in good agreement with the test results obtained in the literatures.28–30 For sleeper displacement of 2 mm, the lateral resistance of sleeper is 8.1 kN, which is slightly smaller than the minimum limit of 9.0 kN, as speci ̄ed by the Chinese \Code for Design of Railway Track".27 Due to the randomness and discreteness of the ballast particle, the speci ̄ed value in the standard is an average value.
